archief_van: Inventaris van het Huis van Oud-Groeneveld, Gelderland, Nederland
eigendomsgeschiedenis: Acquired by Countess Sophia van Oranje-Nassau in 1775 through her inheritance of the Van Renswijk estate. Passed down to Baron Henri van Merode in 1848 upon Sophia's death, who later bequeathed it to his daughter, Countess Catherine van der Marck, in 1892.
